settings.description: Most runs the instance executes at once; the rest wait.
Most runs one tenant executes at once (never above the instance cap).
Heap use at or above which new runs wait instead of starting.
Most runs one tenant may have waiting before new ones are refused.
Retries of a failed automation run when the automation sets none of its own.
Wait before the first retry; each retry waits twice as long.
Longest wait between retries (never below the base).
Widest date window one run may cover; a safety ceiling.
Extract the two sides of a run at the same time.
Re-check each missing record against its source before reporting it.
A run with no progress for this long is ended as stuck.
A run silent in any stage this long shows as stuck; must stay below the reaper time.
A run silent in the extract stage this long shows as stuck.
A run is slow when it takes this many times its usual duration.
A run is never called slow before it has run this long.
Time a cancelled run gets to stop before it shows as stuck.
A read from the period's first day is flagged once the period is this many days old and the check already played it.
A check that looks records up on this many plays in a row is flagged.
A connection throttled more times than this in one play is flagged.
A connection whose calls rose more than this since the play before is flagged.
Calls rising is flagged only when a play makes at least this many calls.
Wait after a dataset's first failed read; each further failure waits twice as long.
Longest wait between a dataset's failed reads (never below the base).
Failed reads in a row after which a dataset waits for the next day's read, with a warning.
Days before a two-factor deadline on which a reminder goes out.
Days between reminders once the deadline has passed.
Days a new user's temporary password is kept, encrypted, for their welcome emails; gone sooner once they set their own.
Audit findings last seen longer ago than this are deleted by the retention job. Unset keeps them forever.
Finished run results older than this are deleted by the retention job. Unset keeps them forever.
AI transcripts older than this are deleted by the retention job. Unset keeps them forever.
Agent query logs older than this are deleted by the retention job. Unset keeps them forever.
Sync pulse samples older than this, and sync pulse orders closed longer ago, are deleted by the retention job.
Rows the retention job deletes in one transaction.
Generated reconciliation output files older than this are purged nightly.
Raw source extract files older than this are purged nightly (result files stay).
Where run errors and the daily error digest are emailed: one or more addresses, comma-separated. Unset sends no error email.
Darpan-only chat space webhook (Google Chat or Slack) that receives run error cards. Unset posts no cards.
Hour of the day (UTC) the daily error digest is sent.
An automation with no scheduled run for this long is reported as stale in the digest.
Consecutive scheduled runs that read nothing before the digest reports an empty streak.
